setup_note: Review these settings before saving a new local job-search-config.json. Restore existing inputs and complete daily history for an existing search; never overwrite them with examples.

browser_preferences.window_policy: Create one brand-new dedicated Safari window per batch of job-search websites; never reuse an existing window.
browser_preferences.tab_policy: Open each distinct job/application website in its own new tab within that dedicated window.
browser_preferences.scope: User-facing job-search browsing only; unattended collection remains headless.

daily_scraper.once_per_day: One collection attempt per local calendar date, shared by manual and scheduled runs; failed or interrupted attempts are not repeated that day
